transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Arin has gone out to the stable to saddle the horses. Bren and Max are alone in the back room.

transcript.speaker: Bren
transcript.text: "Listen close, I'll say it once. The vault opens on one, seven, three. Tell no one. Not even her."

transcript.speaker: Max
transcript.text: I nod and repeat it under my breath.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: The door swings open and Arin comes back in, brushing straw off her coat.

transcript.speaker: Arin
transcript.text: "You two look guilty. What were you whispering about?"

transcript.speaker: Bren
transcript.text: "Old war stories. Nothing worth your time." He turns away to pack his bag.

transcript.text: In the kitchens, Lady Corva tips a vial of grey powder into the duke's wine jug while the cook's boy Tam is out fetching water.

transcript.speaker: Tam
transcript.text: "Shall I carry the wine up, my lady?"

transcript.speaker: Lady Corva
transcript.text: "Yes, and be quick. His grace hates to wait. It's the good vintage tonight."
